answer: Agents trading jetty designs, summit logistics, or pigment supplies must each lock a $100 bond for 30 days before submitting bids, with one active bid allowed per bond. Creating new names does not create free bidding capacity: an attacker running 1,000 identities must immobilize $100,000 for a month. The mechanism makes flooding the market costly in scarce capital, even when generating identities is nearly free.
